notes.title: Heat the Dark Train! │ Winter update and X-mas SALE
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/45db61a93cc8ed1340c05176295e2a827a645b64.jpg[/img]

Quiet place with snowy ways for rest. The Border City awaits. Heat metal, heat Ann, heat the frozen heart of Dark Train.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/532290/Dark_Train/]WINTER SALE – 80% OFF[/url]
 
[b]TRAILER:[/b]
https://youtu.be/GRqy_kaOt7s
We are getting reports about upcoming strong blizzard. What does it mean? For now, it is sure that Christmas will be covered in snow. 

For this special occasion we decided to add three unique winter levels where you can celebrate calm holiday moments with our railroad conductor Ann 2.35f💙. Keep your eyes open and look for the open windows that are [b]marked by a snowflake[/b]. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/dc7de9906a5387949a3c4dcdce9105e3c6da2f5c.png[/img]

Frozen to the Metal event will be running until the [b]end of January 2018[/b]. After that new levels will be still active but with different content.

Thank you for your support!
Paperash

notes.title: DARK TRAIN – DEEP INTO THE CITY 2 (UPDATE)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/98dfbfd2219f7b2dbf0be646b6bac3009f4c22cc.jpg[/img]

Dear passengers, spring has come and Dark Train's journey is now lined by new levels! 

[b]TRAILER:[/b]
https://youtu.be/cx_wYlW6KUc
[b]FIRST![/b]
Frozen to the metal event rooms and places are still accessible, but there is nothing you can do until next winter. Some of achived souvenirs like “damask knife” or “golden pig” remain in engine room until the game is completed.

[b]IMPORTANT![/b] 
From now steam whistle “trumpet” can be mounted to the main DT chimney (just let Ann play's the Organ for awhile). So we can really talk about a train now!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/72966d761373268e227274257b05c156130f7398.jpg[/img]

[b]RUMMORS:[/b]
Chimney sweepers guild attached a mechanical “splitter” outside one of the factories. “The splitter” could temporarily release Ann from her bound. Now there is no doubt that Ann becomes their important ally.

[b]FIX:[/b]
Outdoor events (windows + periscope) can no longer be repeated. Once the plot is finished and the train get rewarded event is definately done.

Thank you for your support!
Paperash

notes.title: DARK TRAIN – DEEP INTO THE CITY 1 (UPDATE)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/98dfbfd2219f7b2dbf0be646b6bac3009f4c22cc.jpg[/img]

Dear passengers, from now on Dark Train's journey is enhanced by new levels! 

[b]TRAILER:[/b]
https://youtu.be/xm6u94P7T8Y
There are rumours about three mysterious windows in the Borders City which hide some yet undiscovered secrets! It's an abandoned factory of police chief, a playground devoted to forgotten basketball teams, and lastly, an old music room with a really special look-out. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26615398/1bb52801fdd23fc2c3b38767cbcd0d57d5f86df7.jpg[/img]

Each window contains a unique reward for Dark Train. You can image that our main railroad conductor Ann 2.35f💙 is already impatient! So what are you waiting for... Prepare your periscopes!

Thank you for your support!
Paperash
